_schema.cards: Array of EATK-* IDs (duplicates = multiple copies in hand)
_schema.exposedTags: Tags that match player item stealTags for pre-combat stealing
_schema.deckSize: Optional override — if set, randomly draws N from cards pool each combat

ARMORED_GUARD._note: Defensive guard variant. Shield Wall + Pistol + Aimed Shot.

BLACK_MARKET_FENCE._note: Black market operative: Broken Lever improvised melee stagger, Coin Toss distraction, Flee escape. black_market + improvised tags chain into Contraband Hack combo. Stealing any card degrades escape plan.

CATACOMB_SENTINEL._note: Catacomb statue guardian. Guarantees Secret Button opens secret passage (disrupts cover, repositions enemy). Spotlight + Shield Wall + Grapple cover the flanks. Covert + black_market tags on Secret Button enable Silent Recovery combo. Near-statue biome only.

CHURCH_CATACOMBS_WARDEN._note: Catacombs warden: reveal/expose + stun + defensive wall.

CIVILIAN_BRAWLER._note: Brawler: heavy swing + grapple. Fight-club vibe.

CIVILIAN_TYPE_A._note: Baseline civilian: panics and lashes out with a small knife.

CIVILIAN_TYPE_B._note: Grabby civilian: grapple + knife. Mostly control.

CIVILIAN_TYPE_C._note: Shady civilian: coin toss distraction + knife. Loot-flavored.

CONSTRUCTION_WORKER._note: Worker with gear: axe tool swing + brief defensive brace.

CONTRABAND_RUNNER._note: Mid-tier thief. Coin Toss distraction + Knife + Flee.

DATACENTER_SECURITY._note: Server room security: paint/spotlight + aimed shot (high detection).

DROWSY_BEE._note: 1 card with minor poison. Teaches DOT.

FIGHT_CLUB_THUG._note: Fight club: heavy hit + knife + grapple. Steal disarm options.

GENERIC_FLOOR_20._note: Burst + Aimed + Knife + Shield. Defensive variety.

GENERIC_FLOOR_25._note: Burst + Aimed + Frag + Pipe Bomb + Taze. Explosive-heavy escalation.

GENERIC_FLOOR_30._note: Full 6-card hand. Frag + C4 + Taze + Burst + Shield. Late-game guards with military explosives.

GHOST_OPERATIVE._note: 2x Shadow Strike + Knife. Glass cannon ambusher.

GRANNY._note: Granny with a flashlight: exposes player (low damage but high stealth impact).

HEAVY_DRIFTER._note: 2x Shield Wall + Axe + Pistol. Tank. Hard to steal from.

HOMEOWNER_DEFENDER._note: Home defense: pistol + defensive stance. Easy to de-escalate (bribe).

HYDROPONICS_TECH._note: Hydroponics worker-tech: chemical splash + flashlight + knife.

JUNKYARD_SCAVENGER._note: Junkyard: improvised grabs + knife + coin tricks + broken lever. fixed 4-card hand. black_market + improvised synergy chain via Broken Lever (Contraband Hack + Shrapnel Spray). Easy to steal from — 3 exposed tags.

LAZY_CATERPILLAR._note: 2 copies of Nibble. Slightly more durable tutorial enemy.

DEMOLITIONS_EXPERT._note: C4 + Frag + Pipe Bomb + Shield. Full explosive loadout. Heavily telegraphed — player should pickpocket explosives pre-combat or flee.

SMOKE_ENFORCER._note: Charges through smoke and stuns. Ram + Pistol + Taze.

SMOKE_SPOTTER._note: Turns smoke into a detection net. Spotlight + Paint Target + Pistol.

SMOKE_STALKER._note: Prefers smoke + close range. Shadow Strike + Knife + Grapple.

SPOTTER_DRONE._note: Paint Target + Spotlight + Pistol. Detection specialist.

TRANSIT_ENFORCER._note: 2x Ram Charge + Pistol. Lane charger pattern.

TREASURE_GOBLIN._note: Coin Toss + 2x Flee. Wants to escape, not fight. Easy to steal from.

WAREHOUSE_ENFORCER._note: Rope bind + double Pistol Shot chain. Guarantees Rope opens with bind-setup, then two Pistol Shots land with +20 accuracy bonus. Warehouse / transit choke-point enemies.
